items.title: 5.11 General properties of solids (solids ki aam properties) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.11, printed page 109.

blocks.text: Solid ke atoms, molecules ya ions bohat qareeb qareeb bhare hote hain; gas ki tarah yeh aur qareeb nahi aa sakte. Metallic solids mein atoms gend (sphere) jaise gol hote hain. Aise particles ko arrange karne se hexagonal aur cubic close-packed structures bante hain. In mein particles ki outer boundaries (bahar ki hadein) ek doosre ko chhoo rahi hoti hain, magar gol hone ki wajah se woh 74% se zyada jagah nahi bhar sakte. Matlab solid ko aur compress karna (dabana) possible nahi.

Expansion woh property hai jis mein particles ke darmiyan jagah barhti hai. Solids mein attractive forces itni mazboot hain ke temperature barhane se bhi particles ki jagahen mushkil se badalti hain. Solid ke particles apni mean position (ausat jagah) ke gird vibrate karte (larazte) hain. Is liye garam karne se solid ka volume bohat kam barhta hai. Solids ke linear aur cubic expansion ke coefficients hote to hain, magar liquids aur gases ke muqable mein na hone ke barabar.
iii) Motion of particles in solids (particles ki harkat)

Solid ke particles na ek jagah se doosri jagah jate hain (translatory motion), na ghoomte hain (rotational motion). Woh sirf apni mean position ke gird vibrate karte hain. Temperature barhne par yeh vibration tez ho jata hai.
iv) Inter-particle space in solids (particles ke darmiyan jagah)

Solids mein particles ke darmiyan jagah liquids se bohat kam hai, kyunke un ki forces zyada mazboot hain. Qareeb qareeb bhare atoms, molecules aur ions ki wajah se solids aam taur par sakht hote hain, un ke melting points oonche hote hain aur woh bohat stable (mustahkam) hote hain.
v) Inter-particle forces in solids (particles ke darmiyan forces)

Solids mein particles (atoms, ions, molecules) ionic, covalent, metallic ya van der Waals forces se jure hote hain. Yeh forces itni mazboot hain ke particles ko apni jagah par jama deti hain; particles sirf apni mean position ke gird vibrate kar sakte hain.
vi) Kinetic energy based on KMT (KMT ke mutabiq kinetic energy)

Kinetic energy particles ki harkat se aati hai. Solid ke particles sirf vibrate karte hain; na translational harkat karte hain na rotational. Is liye solid ke paas sirf vibrational kinetic energy hoti hai.

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Quick Check 5.8 ke sawal (compression, expansion, translatory motion, habit) kitab topic 5.12.2 ke baad chhapti hai; un ke jawab wahin hain.

items: Solids: compression nahi (close packing, gol particles zyada se zyada 74% jagah), expansion na hone ke barabar, sirf vibration (na translatory na rotational), particles ke darmiyan sab se kam jagah, ionic/covalent/metallic/van der Waals forces, sirf vibrational kinetic energy.
